title: Diana Essential Body & Hair Care
category: Brand Identity • Packaging Design • Product Design • Personal Care
description: Diana Essential Body & Hair Care is a personal care brand focused on body and hair care products. The project centered on developing a recognizable product identity and translating it into a cohesive bath and shower gel packaging collection. The visual direction combines a soft, beauty-oriented aesthetic with distinctive product-specific colors, imagery, and fragrance-inspired visual themes.
challenge: The main challenge was creating a unified packaging system that could accommodate a diverse range of bath and shower gel variants while keeping the Diana brand immediately recognizable. Each fragrance required its own visual personality and color treatment, but the overall collection still needed to feel like part of the same product family. The packaging also needed to communicate the product name, category, Arabic and English information, and key product messaging in a clear and attractive hierarchy.
solution: A flexible packaging system was developed around the Diana logo, featuring a distinctive circular glass-like mark with a flowing blue wordmark. The system was applied consistently across a collection of 1000 ml Bath & Shower Gel products, while each variant received its own visual direction. Pink Sugar uses a bold pink and white radial pattern, Yasmin features rich purple tones with floral elements, Vanilla uses a soft cream palette with floral imagery, Olympia combines coral and pink tones with classical architectural references, Oud uses warm brown and amber tones with oud-inspired imagery, Coconut uses a clean white and beige palette with coconut-inspired visuals, Sauvage uses deep blue tones with an aquatic visual language, and Victoria's Secret uses a dark navy and black palette with ornamental decorative patterns. The packaging combines English and Arabic product information with a consistent label structure and the recurring message 'leaves your skin deeply refreshed, smooth, and hydrated'.
results: The project created a cohesive bath and shower gel collection in which each fragrance has a distinct visual identity while remaining connected through the Diana master brand. The consistent logo placement, packaging structure, bilingual product information, 1000 ml format, and recurring product messaging establish a recognizable family system, while the individual color palettes, imagery, and decorative treatments help differentiate each variant on the shelf.
